// API Client for QualifyAI
import axios from'axios';const API_BASE=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:8000/api/v1';export const fetchAllApplicants=async(token,params)=>{return axios.get("".concat(API_BASE,"/applicants/"),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)},params});};export const submitApplicant=async(formData,token)=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/applicants/"),formData,{headers:{'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data',Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});};export const fetchApplicant=async(id,token)=>{return axios.get("".concat(API_BASE,"/applicants/").concat(id),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});};export const fetchScoringBreakdown=async(id,token)=>{return axios.get("".concat(API_BASE,"/applicants/").concat(id,"/scoring_breakdown"),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});};export const chatWithBot=async(question,applicantId,token)=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/chat/"),{question,applicant_id:applicantId},{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});};export const registerUser=async(username,password,role)=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/register/"),{username,password,role});};export const loginUser=async(username,password)=>{const params=new URLSearchParams();params.append('username',username);params.append('password',password);return axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/login/"),params,{headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}});};
